name: Concertmaster
original_name: 指揮官《コンサート・マスター》
source:
A member of the secret society known as C.R.O.W.N. that's chasing after the main characters. They’re the cracker in charge of manipulating information.

Using the top floor of a high-end hotel as their hideout, they never leave their room and manipulate information from there. 

They believe the world’s information is their plaything. They’re selfish and a sore loser.

Hometown: Germany
